recipebookplus.configuration.modid_prefi:
Determines prefix for search string to let recipe book know you are looking for recipies that are added by certain mod
Default: "@"
recipebookplus.configuration.mod_enabled:
Determines if mod is enabled
If "OFF" reverts the recipe book to vanilla behavior
recipebookplus.configuration.ingredient_:
Determines prefix for search string to let recipe book know you are looking for recipies that use that item
Default: "$"
recipebookplus.configuration.title: RecipeBook+ Configuration
recipebookplus.configuration.use_custom_: Determines which recipe book UI to use. If "ON" then new custom ui is used. Otherwise modified vanilla one will be rendered
recipebookplus.configuration.display_hel: If "ON" then there will be help element on recipe book screen that will display controls and prefixes in a tooltip
text.autoconfig.recipebookplus.option.MO:
Determines if mod is enabled
  If "OFF" reverts the recipe book to vanilla behavior
text.autoconfig.recipebookplus.option.RE: §6INGREDIENT_AND_ITEM§r: discover recipe from inventory change - any ingredient or item itself §a[DEFAULT]§r
§6ITEM§r: discover recipe from inventory change - item itself
§6INGREDIENT§r: discover recipe from inventory change - any ingredient
§6ADVANCEMENT§r: discover recipe from advancement trigger - same way vanilla treats recipe discovery
§6NONE§r: do not discover recipes - can only be awarded with §7/rbp give recipe <target?> <id>§r§8
